title: SDD Seven-Stage Pipeline
description: Studio-first executable representation of the SDD seven-stage flow with readiness routing all 8 primary statuses and ECI re-entry handling all 3 authorization outcomes.
notes: Wave-3 baseline. Step types in scope: command/gate/if/switch. Agent steps halt with exit 42; gates halt with exit 43. Execution goes through the shared runner studio/scripts/powershell/run-workflow.ps1, which is workspace infrastructure, not a workflow-owned entry point.
